extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Earth — Earth is round like a ball (sphere), it is our home, it has land (continents, mountains, plains) and water (oceans, rivers, lakes), it is surrounded by air. Earth rotates on its axis — one rotation takes 24 hours (one day). (2) Sun and shadows — the sun is a huge ball of hot gas, it gives us light and heat, it appears to move across the sky from east to west. Shadows form when an object blocks sunlight. Shadows are long in morning and evening (sun is low), short at noon (sun is overhead). Shadows always point opposite to the sun. (3) Day and night — when our side of Earth faces the sun, it is day. When our side faces away from the sun, it is night. Earth rotates once in 24 hours, giving us one day and one night. The sun does not move — Earth moves. (4) Weather observation — weather is what the sky and air are like each day. Types: sunny (bright sun, no clouds), cloudy (grey clouds), rainy (clouds with rain), windy (strong wind), snowy (snow falling). We observe weather daily — temperature (hot/cold), wind (calm/breezy/stormy), sky (clear/cloudy). (5) Seasons — summer (March-May in India, very hot, wear cotton, drink lots of water), monsoon/rainy (June-September, heavy rain, use umbrella, raincoat), winter (November-February, cold, wear woollen clothes, see fog), spring (flowers bloom, new leaves, pleasant). Misconceptions: 'Earth is flat' (Earth is round like a ball, seen from space), 'sun moves around Earth' (Earth moves around the sun, and Earth rotates to make day and night), 'shadow is beside us at noon' (shadow is shortest at noon because sun is overhead), 'all days are the same weather' (weather changes daily, that is why we observe it). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function EarthSunGame), NOT export default. Export interface EarthSunGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
